# Worksite Safety

> Canada's leading occupational health and safety training provider offering certification courses, fall protection equipment, and compliance solutions across Ontario, Alberta, and nationwide.

Worksite Safety is a 100% Canadian-owned company that has trained over 1.2 million workers in workplace safety. They provide comprehensive safety training (online and in-person), safety equipment from brands like 3M, ZOLL, and Kinedyne, and compliance solutions for employers across Canada.

## Key Topics

- Fall Protection Certification
- Working at Heights
- WHMIS and OHSA Compliance
- CPR and AED Training
- Joint Health and Safety Committee (JHSC)
- Confined Space Entry
- Ground Disturbance
- Workplace Violence and Harassment
- Ontario Health and Safety Regulations
- Alberta OHS Standards
- Automated External Defibrillators (AEDs)
- 3M DBI-SALA Fall Protection
- AODA Accessibility Compliance
- TDG and Dangerous Goods
- Bloodborne Pathogens

## Company Information

- [About Worksite Safety](https://worksitesafety.ca/about): About Worksite Safety: Canada's leading OH&S training provider since 1.2M trained

## Safety Training Programs

- [Fall Protection Certification in Calgary & Edmonton](https://worksitesafety.ca/fall-protection-calendar): Fall protection certification training in Calgary & Edmonton per Alberta OHS
- [Barrie Training Calendar](https://worksitesafety.ca/barrie-safety-training): Safety training calendar at Monte Carlo Inn Barrie location
- [Health and Safety Awareness for Workers](https://worksitesafety.ca/product/training/online/health-and-safety-awareness-for-workers): Online OHSA & WHMIS awareness course for Ontario workers
- [Supervisory Ground Disturbance (201 / Level 2)](https://worksitesafety.ca/product/training/online/supervisory-ground-disturbance): Level 2 supervisory ground disturbance certification for excavation safety
- [Workplace Violence And Harassment - Workers](https://worksitesafety.ca/product/training/online/violence-harassment-workers): Workplace violence and harassment prevention training for workers
- [Bloodborne Pathogens Online Course](https://worksitesafety.ca/product/training/online/bloodborne-pathogens): Online bloodborne pathogens training with infection control protocols
- [AODA Online Certification](https://worksitesafety.ca/product/training/online/aoda): AODA and IASR online certification for Ontario accessibility compliance

## Fall Protection and Confined Space Equipment

- [3M DBI-SALA Advanced Winch/SRL Mating Mounting Bracket](https://worksitesafety.ca/product/equipment/3m-dbi-sala-advanced-winch-srl-mating-mounting-bracket): 3M DBI-SALA winch/SRL bracket for tripod and davit mounting systems
- [3M Protecta Pro Confined Space Winch](https://worksitesafety.ca/product/equipment/fall-protection/3m-protecta-pro-confined-space-winch): 3M Protecta Pro winch with 50ft cable for confined space rescue
